name: 89705 · Carson City, NV
findings: ZIP 89705 (Carson City) has 14 nonprofit organizations. 9 of them (64%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 8 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (50% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 89705 (Carson City) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
33% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 89705 (Carson City) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.3 times the typical level).
